independent_methods.description: For each owner using a frozen-subset selection rule (terra, opus, sonnet), checked g9.production_scale_bounds.*.fit_row_selection / candidate_pool_selection and .selection_excludes against the owner's own submission description of its row/pool freeze key, to confirm cap membership is determined only by seed-bound identity fields and cannot be influenced by features, account state, the selected target, or reward.

findings.title: Both g9 self-hashes and all four submission SHAs independently reproduced with zero discrepancies
findings.detail: protocol_g9.json's self-excluded overlay_hash and protocol_g9.md's SELF_EXCLUDED document hash both reproduced exactly (M1, M2). All four final_owner_submissions SHA-256 values reproduced exactly via direct whole-file byte hashing (M3). The g6/g7/g8 hashes cited in g9.inheritance and g9.supersedes also reproduced exactly against those files' own bytes (M1), so g9's upstream citations are not merely copied from those files' self-declared values but independently corroborated.

findings.title: Cap constants and label-blind identity keys match owner submissions exactly, with no silent loosening
findings.detail: Every numeric cap in g9.production_scale_bounds (8192 fit/candidate rows, 31 quantile thresholds, 1024 LOO queries, 100000 input examples) is an exact restatement of a constant already frozen inside the corresponding owner's own model_submission file, not a new or looser bound introduced only at g9 (M4). All three frozen-subset owners (terra, opus, sonnet) select their capped subset using only a fixed seed plus ExampleID/EventID/DecisionMS-or-neighbor-id, explicitly excluding features, account_context, selected_target_intent, and reward, matching each owner's own anti-leak/order-independence claims (M5). Grok's uncapped, all-100000-row linear scan is unchanged and requires no selection key.
